SystemTable.name: routing_rule
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `routing_rule`( `id` bigint not null auto_increment, `inst_id` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `rule_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `user_name` varchar(32) NOT NULL, `template_id` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL, `keywords` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL, `routing_type` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_updated` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY (`inst_id`,`rule_name`) ) charset=utf8mb4
